query:
insert into PassedTestRuns (
                product_id,
                test_run_name
            )
            with TestRunsWithPassedTestCase (
                product_id,
                test_run_name
            ) as (
                select
                    product_id,
                    test_run_name
                from ResolvedTestCaseStates
                where state = $1
            ), IndirectPassedTestRun (
                product_id,
                test_run_name
            ) as (
                select
                    d.product_id,
                    d.test_run_name
                from TestRunDescendants d, TestRunsWithPassedTestCase p
                where d.product_id = p.product_id
                and d.descendant_test_run_name = p.test_run_name
            )
            select
                product_id,
                test_run_name
            from (
                select
                    product_id,
                    test_run_name
                from TestRunsWithPassedTestCase

                union all

                select
                    product_id,
                    test_run_name
                from IndirectPassedTestRun
            )

            except

            select
                product_id,
                test_run_name
            from (
                select
                    product_id,
                    test_run_name
                from FailedTestRuns

                union all

                select
                    product_id,
                    test_run_name
                from SkippedTestRuns
            )
